nomial in t and A (degree ≤ 7) gets to NMSE ≈ 2e-7, so the true form is not a simple low-order polynomial. Sum-of-exponential, exp(-kA), and exp(kA) variants all stayed around 3–4e-3.

The best recorded candidate is the last one: a polynomial in t and A with A², A³, and cross terms, at NMSE 1.04e-3.
